days.top_line: Oil held near $107 a barrel as Iran refused to soften its Hormuz terms, dragging the Sensex down over 1%. The Supreme Court declined to pause the new UPI fee, while South Africa's
Sunday was tense: UK police foiled a bomb plot near a base used in US strikes on Iran. Kohli passed 15,000 ODI runs, and Anthropic claimed major AI science breakthroughs.
